owner_decision: Owner in chat 2026-09-25: instead of a single pick, carry three picks to the full corpus, one per precision floor, generated together on shared servers, and choose among the final outputs by comparing them.
production: The union of cohort parts (model x arm x format) needed by the three picks is generated once on the full corpus; each pick's output is then derived from those generations with its own stages and pools. Picks are compared on the corpus (agreement/disagreement, per-paper counts) before the owner chooses.
